svg.text: Admit a funded promise; bound waiting separately
Constructed private-block reference • ten slots • two active • two waiting
Initial memory and waiting gates
O3 + R3 + H1 + U3 = ten slots
B cap four waits; C waits behind B
Queue two items / eleven KiB
Reject with explicit reasons
D: both waiting slots already used
E cap ten: ordinary limit only nine
F thirteen KiB: input policy limit twelve
Terminal is not physical retirement
A terminal returns three unused credits
Its old reader still holds three blocks
O/R/H/U = 3/0/1/6 before promotion
Promotion transfers funded claims
B promotion: 5/2/1/2; queue C remains
C promotion: 6/3/1/0; queue empty
A final reader ends: 3/3/1/3
Every row preserves ten slots; queue credits do not represent all downstream memory.
B/C remain execution-live after the queue empties. A is outside the five-arrival cohort.
